name: Yam
description: Fresh yam tubers, a staple sold in markets across many parts of Nigeria.

name: Cassava
description: Cassava roots used for garri, fufu, and other everyday foods.

name: Cocoyam
description: Cocoyam corms and leaves used in soups and traditional dishes.

name: Garri
description: Cassava granules sold in different textures and colours for soaking or cooking.

name: Plantain
description: Green and ripe plantain for frying, roasting, boiling, and local dishes.

name: Banana
description: Fresh bananas from local growers and produce traders.

name: Pineapple
description: Whole fresh pineapples, with varieties and supply changing by season.

name: Mango
season: Seasonal; commonly abundant in the dry season
description: Sweet local mangoes when in season; availability differs across regions.

name: Pawpaw
description: Ripe and unripe pawpaw sold for eating fresh or cooking.

name: Tomatoes
description: Fresh tomatoes for stews, sauces, and everyday cooking.

name: Fresh Pepper
description: Fresh peppers, including hot varieties used in Nigerian cooking.

name: Onions
description: Red and white onions sold loose or in sacks, depending on the market.

name: Okra
description: Fresh okra for soups and stews.

name: Ugu (Fluted Pumpkin Leaves)
description: Ugu leaves commonly used in soups and vegetable dishes.

name: Waterleaf
description: Tender waterleaf sold fresh for soups and stews.

name: Bitterleaf
description: Fresh or processed bitterleaf used in regional soups.

name: Palm Oil
description: Red palm oil sold in measured quantities and larger containers.

name: Fresh Fish
season: Availability varies by catch and location
description: Fresh fish sold at markets supplied by coastal and inland fisheries.

name: Dried Fish
description: Smoked and dried fish used to add flavour to soups and stews.

name: Crayfish
description: Dried crayfish sold whole or ground as a cooking ingredient.

name: Periwinkle
description: Fresh or prepared periwinkle commonly used in Niger Delta dishes.

name: Beans
description: Beans sold in bulk or smaller measures for meals such as moi moi and akara.

name: Rice
description: Locally produced and imported rice sold in bags or smaller quantities.

name: Maize
description: Fresh or dried maize, depending on the season and market.

name: Egusi
description: Melon seeds sold whole or ground for soups.

name: Grapes
description: Fresh grapes, including imported varieties; check the market for current origin and availability.

name: Watermelon
description: Whole fresh watermelon sourced from local and regional growers when in season.

name: Apples
season: Year-round in many markets; origin varies
description: Fresh apples sold by piece or in packs; varieties and country of origin vary.

name: Pears
description: Fresh pears, including imported varieties; check the market for current origin and availability.

name: Avocado
description: Fresh avocados from local and regional growers, with availability changing through the year.

name: Potatoes
description: Fresh potatoes sold for household cooking and food service.

name: Cabbage
description: Whole fresh cabbages supplied by local and regional growers.

name: Citrus Fruit
description: Citrus fruit such as oranges and mandarins, depending on season and source.
